bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/gaybbs.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = dbf1e514fe17f532bce3c97ba97031715096dc578b36c9dc7b2687a5dd4c1ee8 || exit 51
test "$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 sha256sum /app/backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$(sha256sum deploy/state/recruit-pr82-7363a913/backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs | cut -d' ' -f1)" || exit 52
pg_before="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)"
ub_before="$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)"
test "$ub_before" != 0
before="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs --dry-run)"
applied="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs --apply)"
after="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/backfillExistingRecruitmentCards.mjs --dry-run)"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Id}}' deploy-postgres-1)" = "$pg_before"
test "$(systemctl --user show -p MainPID --value gace-userbot-verify.service)" = "$ub_before"
python3 - "$before" "$applied" "$after" <<'PY'
import json,sys
b,a,z=map(json.loads,sys.argv[1:])
for x in (b,a,z):
    assert x["unresolved"]==x["uncertain"]==x["nonPublishedUnresolved"]==0
assert a["updatedSources"]==a["eligibleSources"]
assert a["updatedReceipts"]==a["eligibleReceipts"]
assert z["eligibleSources"]==z["eligibleReceipts"]==0
assert z["alreadyCurrent"]==z["sentReceipts"]
print(f'RECRUITMENT_MIGRATION_PASS sources={z["publishedSources"]} receipts={z["sentReceipts"]} changed_sources={a["updatedSources"]} changed_receipts={a["updatedReceipts"]}')
PY
